goal: Prevent the node from abruptly crashing when disk writes fail during block storage
Enable clean error reporting and graceful shutdown instead of sudden process aborts
reviewability: Reviewable immediately with nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Support from a contributor who ran into the same bug while working in this area (w0xlt)
Asked why storage write errors should be caught instead of crashing, answered by author (andrewtoth)

Allows callers to safely catch and handle write errors during buffered I/O
